chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Salamah ibn al-Khattab, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Zur‘ah ibn Muhammad, from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, who said:

Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام) said: “Indeed, Sulayman inherited Dawud, and indeed Muhammad inherited Sulayman, and indeed we inherited Muhammad, and indeed with us is the knowledge of the Tawrah, the Injil, the Zabur, and the clarification of what is in the Tablets.”
He said: I said, “Surely this is the knowledge.” He said: “This is not the knowledge. The knowledge is that which comes into occurrence day after day and hour after hour.”

key_terms.التَّوْرَاةِ: the Tawrah; the revealed scripture given before Islam
key_terms.الزَّبُورِ: the Zabur; the Psalms associated with Dawud عليه السلام
key_terms.الْأَلْوَاحِ: the Tablets; the written tablets containing divine revelation
key_terms.الْإِنْجِيلِ: the Injil; the Gospel revealed to Prophet Isa عليه السلام
key_terms.عِلْمَ: knowledge; here, sacred and divinely bestowed knowledge
key_terms.وَرِثَ: inherited; received as a transmitted legacy of knowledge and authority
key_terms.يَحْدُثُ: occurs or comes into being; indicating ongoing, renewed knowledge

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) describe the inherited knowledge of the Imams?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imams (عليهم السلام) inherit the knowledge passed down through the Prophets, including the revealed scriptures and what was contained in the Tablets. It further distinguishes inherited textual knowledge from a living, continually renewed knowledge that occurs day by day and hour by hour.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Zur’a Bin Muhammad, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Suleyman<sup>as</sup> inherited Dawood<sup>as</sup>, and that Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> inherited Suleyman<sup>as</sup>, and we<sup>asws</sup> are the inheritors of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and that in our<sup>asws</sup> presence is the Knowledge of the Torah, and the Evangel, and the Psalms, and the explanation of what is in the Tablets’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘This Tablet, is the Knowledge?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is not the Knowledge. The Knowledge is that which occurs day after day, and moment after moment’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salama ibn al-Khattab from ‘Adallah ibn Muhammad from ‘Adallah ibn al-Qasim from Zur‘a ibn Muhammad from al-Mufaddal ibn ‘Umar from who has said the following.

“Solomon inherited David. Muhammad (s.a.) inherited Solomon and we inherited Muhammad (s.a.). We have the knowledge of Torah and the Gospel (Injil), the Psalms, (al-Zabur) and the explanation of what the tablets contained.”
I (the narrator) said, “This certainly is the knowledge.” The Imams (a.s.) said, “This is not knowledge. Knowledge is what happens day after day and hour after hour.”
